data.summary: Results-driven Project Manager with 11+ years of experience delivering large-scale, regulated technology and transformation programs across global banking and financial services organizations (Standard Chartered, Northern Trust). Proven track record in portfolio governance, financial control, RAID and risk management, stakeholder engagement and Agile delivery (Certified SAFe Agilist). Skilled in managing multi-million-dollar regulatory change programs, driving executive-level reporting and ensuring audit and regulatory readiness within highly controlled banking environments. Adept at partnering with Finance, Technology, Business and PMO teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

all_skills: Project & Portfolio Governance • Financial Management & Budgeting • RAID & Risk Management • Stakeholder & Vendor Management • Change Request Governance • Regulatory & Audit Compliance • Resource & Capacity Planning • Agile / SAFe Delivery • Executive & Steering Committee Reporting • Banking & Financial Services Domain Expertise • Clarity • JIRA • Azure DevOps (ADO) • Confluence • SharePoint • MS Excel • Tableau

responsibilities: Managed governance, delivery oversight, financial controls, and stakeholder engagement across multiple portfolios, including Risk Monitoring & Insights (RMI), CFCR TOM, Risk Advice, and KTLO initiatives.
Led daily delivery forums, portfolio reviews and cross-functional stakeholder meetings to track progress, resolve issues and drive execution against strategic objectives.
Developed executive-level governance artifacts including status reports, steering committee packs, leadership updates and fortnightly business review materials.
Managed resource planning and governance including capacity management, workforce forecasting, timesheet compliance, allocation management and CAPEX tracking.
Led Change Request governance through template development, impact assessments, stakeholder reviews, approval coordination and implementation tracking.
Supported audit and regulatory readiness through evidence collection, documentation management, control validation and SharePoint governance.

Created executive presentations, go-live readiness assessments and operating model documentation; facilitated collaboration across Business, Product, Technology, AI and Operations teams to resolve escalations and drive strategic change initiatives.

Managed overall financial and budgeting activities for a multi-year regulatory change program valued over USD 2.5M, including vendor costs, forecasting and accrual tracking via Clarity, with weekly and monthly leadership dashboards.
Managed resource time allocation and reporting, partnering with project managers on cost-saving and resource optimization strategies.

experience.company: Delivered PMO support for the bank's global obsolescence program, driving removal and replacement of critical end-of-support systems across Standard Chartered's global technology estate.
responsibilities: Managed e-procurement, accruals, cost uploads and PO controls, reconciling Clarity financial reports against project budgets.
Led monthly finance reviews with workstream leads and PMs, managed resource allocations in Clarity and maintained forecast and budget summaries for senior stakeholder reviews.
Supported database migrations, website configuration and application enhancements for global SaaS clients.

education.institution: Master of Computer Applications — Grade: 79.25% Jyoti Nivas College, Bengaluru (2012–2015)
